title: Archuleta reports a crashed plane to the Air Force
summary: Scott Ramsay tells of Archuleta reports a crashed plane to the Air Force, about March 25, 1948 at Sandia National Laboratories, Albuquerque, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Archuleta ranch / Kirtland Air Force Base, New Mexico

tellings.quote: He calls the Air Force and he [music] says, "Hey, one of your planes crashed over here. You need to come get it."

plain: A researcher named Scott Ramsay, on a podcast episode about a reported crash with alien bodies in New Mexico, retells what a rancher named Valentine Archuleta did in March 1948. According to Ramsay, Archuleta called the Air Force, linked to Kirtland Air Force Base near Albuquerque, and said one of their planes had crashed on his land and they needed to come get it. The call is told as the start of the crash story.
